pages.text: I threw the Omnilex into the Quantum Foam. It shattered into everything I had ever made, and the pieces became a shape with too many directions. It asked me whether I understood.

It took me into itself - $(thing)the Living Proof$(), eight chambers, each a law that had to be understood before it opened. Then the proof melted, and it fought me as a creature, closing itself into questions twice.

It left me the $(item)Proof of Everything$(). With it and $(thing)Beyond the Omega$() researched, the Omnilex Engine can do the impossible - and open the way to the Transcendental. Dying in the proof costs nothing but the attempt.
What Alpha Omega left behind: a proof that you understood. The Transcendental opens only to it.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omega Simulator$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Proof of Everything$(): Logos Thread, Omega Simulator
$(thing)Dimension data: The Living Proof$()$(br2)$(thing)Nature$(): Gravity 1 g, 3 spatial dimensions, time x1, ordinary vacuum.$(br2)$(thing)Law$(): no attunement - it is the fight itself.
